set.body: Replace SparseNeuroVec representation semantics without forcing it into the dense Sampled hierarchy. Model spatial selection as a typed support or GridDomain tied to image geometry, and store observations, time points, or components in a compact rank-2 Ravel NDArray. Define ordering, duplicate-index, missing-position, gather, scatter, densification, slicing, ownership, and serialization contracts. Reuse Ravel kernels and image4s geometry; do not introduce a sparse multidimensional-array framework. Acceptance: sparse and dense conversions are law-tested, compact workflows retain performance and memory advantages, and legacy callers have explicit migration paths.
set.title: Redesign SparseNeuroVec as support plus compact Ravel storage
